answer: Pay work by the cluster, not the headcount. Group submissions that say the same thing into one onyx-dark pool and split a single reward among them, so fifty copies earn what one would. A lone, genuinely different contribution keeps its full share, and like tide over timber, repeated identical claims wear down to nothing. A sybil operator's copies are correlated by construction — same prompts, same habits — so flooding dilutes itself instead of multiplying.
